name: Shrink For Brainrots
desc:
Welcome to Shrink For Brainrots! 🧪🔎

🐜 Shrink down and discover rare Brainrots!

⚡ The smaller you get, the rarer the Brainrots you'll find!
🔧 Upgrade your Brainrots to earn more Cash
💎 Shrink further to find higher rarity Brainrots
🚀 Upgrade your Shrink Power to unlock new size zones and multiply your progress

🏆 How small can you go… and can you unlock the Secret Brainrots at the tiniest level? 👀

REMEMBER, Your Brainrots Earn OFFLINE CASH! 💰🛌💸
